title: createSlice
description: Learn how to create Redux slices with createSlice and eliminate boilerplate.

data.text: **createSlice** is one of Redux Toolkit's most powerful features. It generates action creators and action types automatically from your reducer definitions, and uses **Immer** so you can write 'mutating' code that's actually immutable.

A 'slice' represents a single feature of your app and bundles state, reducers, and actions together. Think of it as a self-contained module for one part of your global state — like `counter`, `todos`, or `user`.

data.title: createSlice
Immer Under the Hood
data.text: createSlice uses Immer internally. You write code that looks like mutation, but Immer produces a new immutable state object behind the scenes. This is why you can write `state.value += 1` safely.

data.text: When you call `createSlice`, the `name` property becomes the prefix for all action types. For example, a slice named `'todos'` with a reducer `addTodo` produces the action type `'todos/addTodo'`. The action creator is automatically exported as `addTodo`.

data.text: Sometimes you need to transform the payload before it reaches the reducer. Use the `prepare` callback to compute and validate the payload. This is useful for generating IDs or normalizing input.

data.text: Because Immer is used under the hood, you can write nested updates just like you would with regular mutable JavaScript. No more deep spreading or libraries like `lodash.set`.

data.title: Create a Todos Slice
data.description: Create a `todosSlice` with `addTodo`, `toggleTodo`, and `removeTodo` reducers. Use a prepare callback to auto-generate an `id` for each todo. The state should be an array of objects with `id`, `text`, and `completed` properties.
steps: Use Date.now() or crypto.randomUUID() for id generation
toggleTodo finds the todo by id and flips completed
removeTodo filters the array by id

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: createSlice bundles state, reducers, and actions in one place
Immer lets you write 'mutating' code that produces immutable updates
Action types and creators are generated automatically
Use prepare callback for payload validation and transformation
data.takeaway: createSlice is the heart of Redux Toolkit — it removes boilerplate and makes state management feel natural.
